reviews.title: 10+ hour per day developer review
reviews.comment:
At first I wanted to return this deskmatt because the black is very easy to stain. A simple bit of dirt or a bit of food crumb from lunch sticks to this deskmatt and it shows. I’m not a perfectionist and I will use it for years, but I think that many people will end up with faded black (where your wrist go) after 12-18 months.
The charging for the iPhone works good and I have no complaints with it. The AirPod charging works but you have to put the case in just the right position else it won’t charge or it will beep every few seconds because it has enough to connect to the case but not enough to charge it. Basically there is a margin of less than1/2 inch in all directions for it to charge. You can also throw AirPods in the iPhone charger though. Overall the charging is solid.
I use a keyboard without the numpad and it is has about 6inches of space on the right and 4inches of usable space on the left. The right has just enough for my large Logitech mouse. The left though… even though it has 4inches of space it really has closer to 3inches of space because where the fabric meats the leather(pleather?) it starts to lift up a little bit because the two materials need to connect. It’s not a big issue, but it is noticeable if you put something by where these two meet.
I think if you were using a larger/standard keyboard without a numpad and a larger mouse it will get pretty tight. They will still fit obviously, but if you use 2/3/4 monitors you will regularly hit the edge of the fabric IMO.
Do I think I could have found a better deskmatt and a separate charger setup? Probably.
Do I regret buying this? Not at all, it was a fair price, is high quality, and meets my needs.
reviews.author: Sean

reviews.title: My Productivity Went Down, My Phone Battery Went Up
reviews.comment:
I bought this to “streamline my workspace,” which is what people say when they’re avoiding actual work. The wireless charging works flawlessly — my phone now sits at 100% all day while I accomplish 0% of my tasks.
The mouse glides beautifully across the surface, which is great because I’m now scrolling Reddit with alarming precision and speed. It’s a large pad, so both my mouse AND my excuses have plenty of room to roam.
My desk looks incredible. My boss remains unimpressed. My phone, however, has never been happier. Five stars.​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​​
reviews.author: Tino Fernandez

reviews.title: A quality Mousepad and Charger
reviews.comment:
I’ve had this mouse pad for over a week now and still have mixed feelings with it. I’ve gone to great lengths to get it to lay flat, including putting heavy jars of candy on it and it still will not lay flat. I’ve ultimately had to tape down a few parts — fortunately this ensures that it does not slip.
The phone charger works great. The magnet is strong and charges moderately quickly. The size is fantastic and perfectly matches my 40” monitor.
My one complaint is that the AirPods charger does not work the best. It has to be in the perfect spot for it charge with a case on. Additionally, my AirPods do not charge on the MagSafe charger which they do on every other MagSafe charger made.
Overall, I’d buy it again and I’d recommend it for others.
reviews.author: Jarrod D

reviews.title: Plain and simple which is just want I needed
reviews.comment: Ok let's just be real: this is not the highest quality desk pad you can find. But for the price, the dimensions and functionality can't be beat. And it's not bad,  I just wouldn't call it premium. I give it 5 stars because just works, it does what it's supposed to do. I provides a stylish place to put my fullsize keyboard and ergo mouse with some extra room, including my wrist pad. And the thing that's really nice is that the charging piece can be on either side of the mat. The charging is fast enough and has a very satisfying feel once the phone is connected.
